verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a free, fully-featured Sandbox environment for development and testing. It supports all Plaid API and Link functionality and allows unlimited test Items. A Sandbox-only endpoint (/sandbox/public_token/create) lets code or agents programmatically create test Items with test credentials, without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Sandbox behavior, and any evidence that agent tooling (e.g., the MCP server, which targets Production diagnostics) works against Sandbox.
